proposal.note: The missing determiners in “did captain” and “Ordered guard” can be corrected, but wording changes cannot resolve the reported context problem. The supplied passage neither identifies the captain nor mentions the plan, so it does not establish that the protective orders were his response to that plan. Preserving this required relationship would require additional passage context; removing it would change the question. With the window and key fixed, D cannot be established uniquely over E.
